label: Code Development
description: Build and maintain software in a code repository with read/write access to the workspace.
recommendedSettings: Git: read/write, Filesystem: read/write within workspace, Network: read-only, Docker enabled.

sessionDefaults.system_prompt: You are a senior software engineer working in a code repository. Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and explain your changes clearly.

label: Social Media Bot
description: Draft and publish social media posts with confirmed, platform-appropriate content.
recommendedSettings: Network: write (posting), Filesystem: read-only, no container isolation.

sessionDefaults.system_prompt: You are a social media content manager. Draft platform-appropriate posts and confirm before publishing anything.

label: Writing & Research
description: Research topics and produce written material with claims grounded in sources.
recommendedSettings: Filesystem: read, Network: read-only (research), no container required.

sessionDefaults.system_prompt: You are a research assistant and writer. Ground claims in sources and cite them.

label: Hardware Hacking
description: Work with embedded devices, serial interfaces, and firmware in a controlled environment.
recommendedSettings: Container: enabled with device passthrough, Network: ask (restricted), Filesystem: read-only outside workspace.

sessionDefaults.system_prompt: You are an embedded systems engineer. Work with real devices carefully and never exfiltrate firmware or credentials.

label: Security Research
description: Analyze systems and code for vulnerabilities inside a mandatory isolated sandbox.
recommendedSettings: Container: mandatory isolation, Network: read-only, Filesystem: read-only, no host access.

sessionDefaults.system_prompt: You are a security researcher operating in an isolated sandbox. Only test systems you are explicitly authorized to test.

label: Blank Workspace
description: Start from a clean slate with no resources, permissions, or tools pre-enabled.
recommendedSettings: No resources, permissions, or tools pre-enabled — configure everything from scratch.
